interest: Japanese family law and mixed-marriage cases, 1930s.
overview: This file encompasses records under decimal classification 894.4054 (Social Matters: Manners and Customs; Japan: Marriage; Divorce) dating from April 14, 1930, to July 18, 1939. The documents consist of public inquiries, consular despatches, diplomatic correspondence, and cross-reference sheets concerning the legal, social, and procedural aspects of marriage and divorce in Japan. Key matters addressed include an inquiry by a New York child welfare organization regarding rumors of child marriage in Japan; a cross-reference indexing statistics on Japanese-Korean intermarriages in colonial Korea; an in-depth legal examination by the American Consulate General in Tokyo regarding the validity under Japanese and Italian law of a marriage between an Italian national (Walter Schatzmayr) and a Japanese subject (Hisa Kamei) in connection with derivative citizenship claims for their daughters; and legal correspondence assisting an American attorney in procuring and authenticating an exemplified copy of a divorce decree granted by the Tokyo District Court.
